pricing_basis.description: Base freight is charged per kilometre of the booked lane distance, at a rate that varies according to the consignment's billed weight band.

premiums.name: Express service premium
premiums.condition: Express service is booked for the consignment.

surcharges.name: Fuel surcharge
surcharges.condition: Applies to every consignment's freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

accessorial_charges.name: Residential delivery
accessorial_charges.condition: Consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential.

accessorial_policy.note: Clause 5 states no other accessorial charges are payable under this agreement; any service outside this schedule requires the Customer's prior written agreement via a rate confirmation referencing this agreement.

exclusions.description: Consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside this rate card — no rate_band or flat_rate applies.

ambiguities.description: Clause 1 defines bands as 'up to and including 500 kg' (≤500) and '501 kg to 2,000 kg' (≥501, ≤2,000). A billed weight strictly between 500 kg and 501 kg (e.g. 500.5 kg) is covered by neither band, since the first band's literal upper bound is ≤500 and the second's literal lower bound is ≥501. This is a genuine gap in the rate card, not a resolved boundary.

Clause 4 triggers the residential accessorial on two distinct conditions — 'consignee address is a residence' or 'the booking is flagged residential' — but the contract does not specify how a residential address is determined from shipment data as opposed to an explicit residential flag on the booking. The structured trigger here assumes both conditions are captured by a 'residential' entry in special_handling; if address-based residential status is tracked separately, this trigger would not fire for that case.

notes: Service covers full and part truckload road carriage on all-India lanes.

The 12% fuel surcharge's compounding base depends on whether the express premium applied; per clause 3 it is levied on base freight alone when express was not booked, and on base freight plus express premium when it was.
